title: Speakers
hints: There is no `implements`: once `Dog`, `Cat` and `Robot` each have `Name() string` and `Sound() string`, they are `Speaker`s. `Greet`, `Chorus` and `CountSound` only call the two interface methods.
`Robot.Name` is `fmt.Sprintf("%s-v%d", r.Model, r.Version)`. `Greet` is `s.Name() + " says " + s.Sound() + "!"`.

For `Chorus`, append `Greet(s)` for every speaker into a `[]string` and return `strings.Join(parts, " ")` (joining an empty slice gives `""`). `CountSound` is a loop with `if s.Sound() == sound { n++ }`.
